description: Chain fold, `X.catch(b)`: non-throwing if X is, else `b`'s color. It is the one row that is not a join — `b` runs only on a rejection, so a throwing handler over a clean source colors nothing.

diagnostics.message: Awaiting `rejects().catch(dirty)` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the body producing it was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
